name: Anchor color
description: Read a named lower-layer color snapshot after its effects. The source must be below this layer.

name: Anchor value
description: Read a named lower-layer material or mask channel after its effects.

name: Boolean
description: Provide a true or false constant for switches and conditions.

name: Color
description: Provide a linear RGB color. The artist swatch displays sRGB and converts to linear for the graph.

name: Decal
description: Project RGBA onto an object-space box. Position, size, rotation, depth, edge fade and facing rejection are editable in Paint or Graph. Alpha covers every authored channel. Choose Mask to use just its alpha. A connected vector uses normalized object coordinates.

name: Grayscale Texture
description: Read a texture channel as a scalar mask or material value. Connect Coordinates to share mapping. Linear data avoids color conversion.

name: Image Texture
description: Read an imported texture as linear color. Coordinates can be shared; wrap and filtering can inherit the fill or override it. Drag a library texture onto this node.

name: Integer
description: Provide a whole-number constant for discrete operations.

name: Layer AO
description: Read the attached layer AO before this effect. Mesh map is the source for baked AO.

name: Layer color
description: Read the color of the attached layer immediately before this effect. It is an input snapshot, not a feedback loop.

name: Layer emission
description: Read the attached layer emission before this effect.

name: Layer height
description: Read the attached layer height before this effect.

name: Layer mask
description: Read the attached mask before this graph effect. Useful for modifying existing painted or procedural masks.

name: Layer metallic
description: Read the attached layer metallic value before this effect.

name: Layer normal
description: Read the attached layer normal before this effect as a signed vector.

name: Layer opacity
description: Read the attached layer opacity before this effect.

name: Layer roughness
description: Read the attached layer roughness before this effect.

name: Material ID
description: Per-import material slot index; feed Compare to create material-region masks.

name: Mesh map
description: Read a semantic baked map. Rebaking updates its stable binding. Normals return signed vectors; AO and thickness return values. Missing maps use neutral inputs.

name: Object ID
description: Stable per-import object/group index; feed Compare or Color to Mask to select objects.

name: Paint
description: Editable brush and clone strokes over a procedural input. Paint on UVs or the mesh, then mix the result with any compatible node. Erase restores the input. Opacity remains editable.

name: Paint Flow Map
description: Paint UV flow directions and speed as linear RG data. 0.5/0.5 is stationary. Follow stroke derives direction from the UV brush path; fixed direction and Flip V support export conventions. Edit paint opens the existing brush/stencil workflow. Erase restores the input.

name: Sample Texture
description: Sample any procedural result or texture using a separate coordinate input. Repeat, clamp or mirror with point or alpha-aware linear filtering; normal vectors remain normalized.

name: Value
description: Provide a scalar constant. Use for roughness, metallic, thresholds or blend factors.

name: Vector
description: Provide a three-component vector constant for coordinates, directions or offsets.

name: Vertex Color
description: Interpolated imported RGBA vertex data. Channel colors are data; no automatic display conversion. Missing sets return white.

name: Advanced Warp
description: Multi-directional, non-uniform directional, swirl, skew, trapezoid, mirror and symmetry transforms.

name: Auto Crop
description: Find non-black or non-transparent bounds, then center, fit, crop or stretch. Filtering preserves transparent edges. Empty inputs stay empty.

name: Combine XYZ
description: Pack three scalar X, Y and Z inputs into a vector.

name: Coordinates
description: Shared coordinate source. Choose fill UV, raw UV, position, normal, polar, cylindrical, spherical, box or triplanar projection. Transform once and connect to several textures. Separate XYZ extracts components.

name: Crop
description: Extract a rectangular area. Outside pixels become transparent, or fit the crop to the full output.

name: Distance
description: Calculate distance between two coordinate vectors.

name: Fresnel
description: Calculate a view-dependent edge factor from a normal and exponent. It is an authored approximation for texture use.

name: Mapping
description: Transform a connected vector with scale, rotation and translation. Coordinates provides these controls directly for shared projections.

name: Non-Uniform Rotation
description: Rotate an image per pixel, driven by a rotation map and optional pivot map. Positive turns rotate clockwise. Shared texture coordinates remain editable.

name: Normal Transform
description: Transform a tangent normal map and its directions together. The inverse-transpose slope transform preserves tangent-space normals under scale, rotation and reflection.

name: Polar Transform
description: Convert an image between Cartesian and polar layouts. Pivot, radius, angle and repeat/clamp/mirror sampling are editable.

name: Quad Transform
description: Map an image into an editable four-corner bilinear quad. Supports front/back culling, repeat/clamp/mirror, filtering and a transparent background.

name: Radial Tiling
description: Repeat an attached coordinate around a radial center. This is a transform, not a second coordinate source.

name: Safe Transform
description: Repeat-safe 2D image transform with whole-number tiling, pivot, mirrors and wrap behavior.

name: Separate XYZ
description: Extract X, Y, Z or W from a vector. Use with Coordinates instead of separate coordinate-source nodes.

name: Vector Math
description: Choose vector operations such as addition, dot, cross or normalization.

name: Vector Morph
description: Warp an image along a signed vector field with editable distance and repeat/clamp boundaries.

name: Vector Rotate
description: Rotate a vector around selected axes without translating it.

name: Vector Transform
description: Convert or scale vector components for a different coordinate convention.

name: 3D Gradient
description: Generate a ramp from a chosen component of a 3D coordinate.

name: 3D Perlin Noise
description: Generate periodic 3D gradient noise. Whole-number Tiles repeats across unit coordinates.

name: 3D Simplex
description: Generate periodic 3D simplex noise; Tiles snaps to multiples of three. Use position coordinates for continuous object-space detail.

name: 3D Voronoi
description: Measure distances to 3D random feature points. Use position coordinates for cellular volumes.

name: 3D Voronoi fractal
description: Combine several 3D Voronoi octaves for cellular surface detail.

name: Blue Noise / Progressive
description: Original toroidal progressive farthest-point rank texture. Deterministic seed and tile size; not a copy of Adobe's Blue Noise Fast recipe.

name: BnW Spots
description: Seeded periodic spot fields with soft, clustered or hard recipes.

name: Brick Texture
description: Generate brick rows with mortar and stagger controls.

name: Cells Noise
description: Periodic cellular distances, edges, rounded cells and crack cells.

name: Checker
description: Generate alternating squares from coordinates. Scale controls the number of cells.

name: Directional Noise
description: Anisotropic periodic noise, bands, scratches and streaks.

name: Dirt Noise
description: Multiscale clustered dirt with threshold, coverage, contrast and five recipe modes.

name: Fractal noise
description: Add several 2D noise octaves. Detail and roughness control small-scale variation.

name: Fractal Sum
description: Periodic octave noise with persistence and plain, ridged, billowy and turbulent recipes.

name: Fur Noise
description: Directional tapered fibers, clumps and crossed fur; angle and width controls.

name: Gabor Texture
description: Generate directional oscillating noise from coordinates, orientation and frequency.

name: Gradient
description: Generate a horizontal, vertical or radial grayscale ramp from coordinates.

name: Gradient / Two Points
description: Project coordinates onto a line between two editable points. Interpolate two values with clamp or repeat and an editable curve.

name: Gradient Shapes
description: Linear, reflected, axial, radial or circular gradients from shared coordinates, with pivot, angle, width and gamma.

name: Grunge Noise
description: Distinct procedural concrete, rust, leaks, scratches, spots, galvanic and organic grunge recipes.

name: Magic Texture
description: Generate a bounded repeating multiaxis procedural texture.

name: Messy Fibers
description: Wavy, tangled and crossed periodic fibers with controllable density and thickness.

name: Noise
description: Generate seamless 2D noise. Tiles uses whole-number repetitions; Seed changes its layout.

name: Noise / Patterns
description: Choose an implemented noise or pattern variant with scale, seed and detail controls.

name: Pattern Shapes
description: Procedural stars, polygon grids, weave, pavement, fibers, Gaussian spots and stripes. UV coordinates optional.

name: Random
description: Generate deterministic random values from coordinates and seed.

name: Scratches
description: Deterministic repeating line segments with length, width, density, direction, jitter and seed. Uses an analytic segment distance, not aliased pixel noise.

name: Shape / SDF
description: Generate a bounded analytic shape mask from coordinates.

name: Specialty Noise
description: Original Gaussian, plasma, caustic, liquid, crystal and fibrous noise families with scale and seed.

name: Starburst
description: Seeded radial rays with controllable ray count, width, angular jitter, center and radial falloff. Coordinates can be shared.

name: Text
description: Editable Unicode labels, serial numbers and markings. Installed fonts, alignment, tracking, line spacing, rotation, ink and outline. Color and mask outputs.

name: Tile Pattern
description: Generate an implemented repeating tile pattern.

name: Voronoi
description: Measure distance to the closest 2D random cell feature. Useful for cells and chipped patches.

name: Wave
description: Generate repeating wave bands from coordinates with frequency and variation controls.

name: White noise
description: Generate independent random values per grid cell; use for scatter and jitter.

name: Pattern Scatter
description: Scatter up to four patterns without overlap. Deterministic, bounded placement; transparent silhouettes or conservative bounds, optional seamless edges and distribution mask.

name: Shape Splatter
description: Generate shared local-coordinate, instance ID and coverage data for up to eight shapes. Optional background height influences overlap; placement is a 2D height-field approximation.

name: Shape Splatter Blend
description: Map one of eight textures using shared Splatter data; optionally composite over a background. Normal mode compensates rotations.

name: Shape Splatter Data Extract
description: Extract stable instance IDs, random values, local coordinates or coverage from shared Splatter data.

name: Shape Splatter to Mask
description: Extract all shapes, one instance or a deterministic fraction as a mask.

name: Tile Sampler
description: Six patterns with scale, rotation, color, density, position and selector maps, optional axis scaling and background compositing. Map attenuation controls preserve the legacy full-map default.

name: Cubic Spline
description: Editable four-point cubic Bezier curve in texture coordinates.

name: Layer Splines
description: All splines of a spline layer as paths; uncheck the ones to leave out.

name: Path Merge
description: Combine two independent path sets without joining endpoints.

name: Path Transform
description: Move, rotate and scale curves around a chosen pivot.

name: Polyline
description: Editable 2D points; straight segments, optionally closed.

name: Scatter on Spline
description: Distribute procedural stamps at equal arc-length intervals.

name: Spline Circle
description: Parametric ellipse or circular arc in texture coordinates.

name: Spline Fill
description: Fill closed contours with even-odd or union semantics.

name: Spline Render
description: Rasterize an antialiased path stroke into a reusable mask.

name: Alpha
description: Merge alpha or convert straight and premultiplied RGBA explicitly.

name: Blackbody
description: Approximate the RGB color of a blackbody temperature in Kelvin.

name: Blend
description: Combine background and foreground using a blend mode and optional opacity mask. The result follows the connected data type.

name: Channel Mixer
description: Mix RGB with editable channel weights and bias while preserving alpha.

name: Chrominance
description: Remove luminance from RGB while preserving chromatic differences and alpha. Negative values are retained.

name: Color Gradient
description: Blend two or more colors across the surface: linear, radial, angular, diamond, reflected or square. Connect a value to Factor to use it as a gradient map.

name: Color Match
description: Match source color statistics to a reference image using mean and standard deviation. Transparent pixels do not bias the match. Blend and luminance-only modes are editable.

name: Color Math
description: Apply a selected channel-wise operation to two colors.

name: Color ramp
description: Map a grayscale factor between chosen colors. Useful for coloring noise or baked maps.

name: Color Space
description: Convert color values between supported linear/display encodings.

name: Color Temperature
description: Warm/cool and magenta/green balance for linear color. The graph preserves HDR and alpha.

name: Color to Mask
description: Select colors by RGB distance, tolerance and soft falloff.

name: Combine RGBA
description: Compose independent red, green, blue and alpha fields. Unconnected components use editable defaults.

name: Exposure
description: Multiply linear color or grayscale by 2 to the exposure in stops. Does not clip HDR values or change alpha.

name: Grayscale
description: Convert RGB by luminance, desaturation, average, maximum or minimum channel. Color is already linear in the graph.

name: Hald CLUT
description: Apply an unwrapped Hald color lookup image with trilinear interpolation and explicit level. LUT and color must share an encoding; graph values are linear.

name: HDR Range
description: Highlight components below or above the selected range, or output the invalid-pixel mask. For checking color and data maps.

name: Hue Saturation Value
description: Adjust hue, saturation and value of a linear color input.

name: Nadir Extract
description: Extract the ground-facing view of a panorama for tripod cleanup. Scale and rotation control the perspective footprint. Output remains linear HDR.

name: Panorama Direction
description: Generate a signed unit direction from an equirectangular panorama coordinate. Use it with procedural environment graphs.

name: Panorama Rotation
description: Rotate an equirectangular panorama in 3D. Yaw, pitch and roll affect directions, with repeat-safe longitude and clamped poles.

name: Replace Color
description: Replace a selected color range with a second color, preserving alpha.

name: RGB to grayscale
description: Convert linear RGB color to grayscale using luminance weights.

name: Separate Color
description: Extract a red, green, blue or alpha component from a color.

name: Split RGBA
description: Separate one color texture into named Red, Green, Blue and Alpha scalar outputs. Preserves HDR and negative channel data. Combine RGBA rejoins them.

name: Split XYZ
description: Extract X, Y and Z as three named scalar outputs from one vector input.

name: Value Gradient
description: Blend two or more values (roughness, metallic, masks) across the surface with the gradient shapes. Connect a value to Factor to remap it.

name: Wavelength
description: Approximate the visible RGB color for a wavelength in nanometres.

name: AO Cancellation
description: Remove ambient darkening from color using an AO map. Strength blends the correction; a minimum AO prevents division by zero. Keeps HDR and alpha.

name: Atlas Scatter
description: Scatter alpha-connected atlas elements with deterministic placement, scale and rotation.

name: Atlas Splitter
description: Select an alpha-connected atlas element and fit it to the output; threshold, padding and element index are editable.

name: Auto Levels
description: Analyze full-resolution bounds and normalize grayscale or each RGB channel. Constant inputs stay unchanged.

name: Blur
description: Dense two-pass GPU box/Gaussian smoothing. Spread controls a support radius of twice that value. Fractional sizes are smooth; normal outputs normalize and RGBA uses premultiplied filtering.

name: Clone Patch
description: Clone a positioned source patch onto a destination with size, feather and optional target mask.

name: Color Equalizer
description: Remove low-frequency illumination while preserving chromatic detail and alpha; strength, radius and target luminance.

name: Curvature from Normal
description: Approximate surface curvature from neighbouring normal vectors.

name: Diffusion
description: GPU constrained diffusion: white mask pixels are fixed source values; black regions diffuse neighboring values. Intensity optionally modulates propagation. Color, grayscale and vector modes.

name: Dilate / Erode
description: Expand or shrink bright regions by choosing dilate or erode and radius.

name: Directional blur
description: Average up to seventeen samples along a chosen direction, with a bounded pixel radius.

name: Directional Warp
description: Displace an image in a chosen direction using a scalar warp mask.

name: Edge Detect
description: Find intensity boundaries using neighbouring pixels. Connect a grayscale image; Strength scales the edge mask. Its input is cached before sampling.

name: Emboss
description: Height-gradient lighting with azimuth, elevation, strength and gloss controls.

name: FXAA
description: Edge-aware image antialiasing with contrast thresholds and bounded subpixel blending. Samples premultiplied RGBA and preserves sharp, low-contrast regions.

name: Glow
description: Add an alpha-aware Gaussian glow in scene-linear color. Radius is in pixels; strength and threshold are adjustable. Preserves source alpha.

name: Height to Normal
description: Convert neighbouring height samples into a tangent-space normal. Connect Base normal to combine existing normal detail with height. Strength controls the slope response. Normal maps and heights are linear data, never display color.

name: High pass
description: Subtract a bounded neighbourhood average to isolate fine detail around mid-gray.

name: Histogram range
description: Compress or expand a grayscale distribution around a midpoint.

name: Histogram scan
description: Turn a grayscale image into a threshold mask. Position selects the threshold; contrast controls edge softness.

name: Histogram Scan Non-Uniform
description: Threshold an image with per-pixel position and contrast maps. Disconnected maps use the editable values.

name: Histogram select
description: Select a grayscale band around a position, with adjustable width and softness.

name: Histogram Shift
description: Offset grayscale or RGB values, optionally wrapping the range.

name: Levels
description: Remap input black/white levels and gamma into a chosen output range. Useful for tightening procedural masks.

name: Lighting Cancellation
description: Cancel low-frequency illumination or high-frequency shading independently; neutral target and strength controls.

name: Luminance Highpass
description: Remove Gaussian low-frequency luminance, with signed or centered output and explicit pixel radius.

name: Make It Tile Patch
description: Offset seams, quilt overlapping source patches and feather their boundaries. Editable seed and patch scale.

name: Make It Tile Photo
description: Periodic boundary correction removes opposite-edge discontinuities while retaining photograph details.

name: Make tileable
description: Blend opposing image borders through half-tile-shifted samples. Adjust U and V blend widths; signed normals are normalized. This is edge blending, not content-aware reconstruction.

name: Mosaic
description: Multi-pass gradient warp driven by a grayscale map. Accentuate peaks with intensity and sample controls; preserves the input type and alpha.

name: Multi Clone Patch
description: Apply multiple deterministic clone patches with repeat-safe edges and optional mask.

name: Multi-Angle to Albedo
description: Combine two to eight aligned captures under different lights using a robust average or maximum estimate.

name: Multi-Angle to Normal
description: Photometric stereo from aligned images with evenly spaced known light angles and elevation. Outputs signed tangent normals.

name: Noise Upscale
description: Reconstruct an input noise on a coarse grid and add controllable periodic high-frequency detail.

name: Non-uniform blur
description: Blur an image by a radius controlled by a second mask; up to seventeen samples.

name: Offset
description: Shift the attached image or mask in UV space with repeat wrapping. Half a tile exposes the existing borders at the center for painting.

name: Radial Blur
description: Rotational or zoom blur around an editable UV center. Linear interpolation and premultiplied color sampling.

name: Sharpen
description: Unsharp mask with pixel radius, amount and threshold. Preserves input alpha.

name: Slope Blur
description: Perturb a sampled image along gradients of a connected slope field.

name: Smart Auto Tile
description: Patch quilting followed by periodic boundary correction; editable scale, overlap and seed.

name: Transform 2D
description: Resample an image with scale, rotation and offset in UV space.

name: Vector warp
description: Distort an image using a vector displacement field. Amount scales the offset; both input fields are cached.

name: Curvature
description: Normal-map curvature with smooth or Sobel derivatives and separate Curvature, Convexity and Concavity outputs. Flat areas are 0.5 in Curvature and zero in the other outputs.

name: Facing Normal
description: Tangent-space facing mask: a flat normal returns white and a grazing normal returns black. Accepts signed normals or encoded RGB with automatic decoding.

name: Height AO
description: Horizon occlusion from a heightfield. Image-space approximation, not mesh ray tracing.

name: Height Blend
description: Blend scalar heights using an adjustable transition factor.

name: Height Frequencies
description: Split height by two Gaussian scales and map low, middle and high frequencies independently. Pixel radii and signed gains are editable.

name: Height to Normal / World Units
description: Derive normals from a heightfield using physical surface width, length and height in matching units. Central or Sobel gradients; optional base normal uses RNM.

name: Normal Blend
description: Combine two normal vectors while retaining surface direction. Use for layered normal details.

name: Normal invert
description: Flip selected signed normal-vector components to change orientation.

name: Normal Map
description: Decode an RGB normal texture into a signed unit normal; adjust strength and normal convention.

name: Normal normalize
description: Normalize a normal vector safely; a zero vector falls back to a flat normal.

name: Normal Sobel
description: Convert height to tangent normals with a full 3 by 3 Sobel kernel. Strength and optional base normal remain editable.

name: Normal to Height
description: Reconstruct height by a bounded Poisson solve. Periodic or clamped borders; integrated height has arbitrary offset.

name: Normal to Height HQ
description: Multigrid Poisson integration of signed tangent normals. World dimensions, periodic/clamped boundaries and optional normalization.

name: Normal Vector Rotation
description: Rotate tangent normal directions without moving pixels. An optional grayscale map modulates the angle. Angles are measured in turns.

name: Bevel
description: Create a rounded, linear or smooth height profile from mask-island boundaries. Width is in pixels; height is signed. Repeat-safe cached CPU distance processing.

name: Distance Field
description: Exact pixel-center Euclidean distance to a thresholded mask boundary. Inside, outside and signed outputs, with repeat-safe tile edges. Range is in pixels; cached CPU analysis.

name: Flood Fill
description: Identify 4-connected mask islands, including tile-edge connections. Output per-island random grayscale/color, index, center, bounding size or gradient. Cached full-resolution CPU analysis.

name: Flood Fill Mapper
description: Eight patterns mapped to island index, center and bounds, with scale, rotation, color, selection, axis scaling and fit controls.

name: Mask Region
description: Select mesh triangles, connected faces, UV islands or separate objects and produce UV-space mask coverage.

name: Shape Style
description: Distance-based stroke, glow, drop shadow or extend. Pixel width, strength and offsets.

name: Summed Area Table
description: Inclusive prefix sum from the top-left pixel. Stores raw HDR sums in full precision; optional normalization divides by pixel count.

name: Base Material
description: Build an editable eight-channel PBR material. Connected maps replace uniform values. Defaults are neutral and normal data stays signed.

name: Dielectric F0
description: Normal-incidence dielectric reflectance from preset material ranges or custom index of refraction: ((IOR - 1) / (IOR + 1)) squared.

name: Make Material
description: Estimate editable PBR maps from base color. Eight separate channel outputs; generated relief and roughness are estimates, not recovered measurements.

name: Material Adjustment
description: Adjust each material channel with independent Levels; normal strength uses signed normalized directions. One mask fades the complete adjustment.

name: Material Blend
description: Blend two complete materials with a shared mask, independent channel opacity and blend modes. Normals support replacement, whiteout and RNM.

name: Material Color Blend
description: Blend editable uniform channel values over a material using a shared mask. Channels start disabled so the node is neutral until you enable one.

name: Material Crop
description: Crop or fit a rectangle consistently across all eight material channels. Optional normal compensation preserves the transformed tangent directions.

name: Material Height Blend
description: Blend complete materials by their signed height difference. Height offset, transition softness, bottom priority and independent channel blending stay editable.

name: Material Switch
description: Switch all eight channels between two materials with one boolean map or the editable fallback. Does not convert normals into color arithmetic.

name: Material Transform
description: Transform all material maps together. Tangent normals use the same image transform with inverse-transpose direction correction.

name: Metal Reflectance
description: Linear RGB reference reflectance for gold, silver, aluminium, iron, copper, titanium, nickel, cobalt or platinum. Editable intensity keeps the chosen metal identity.

name: Multi-Material Blend
description: Blend three eight-channel materials with two masks. Normals use reoriented blending; channels remain separate named outputs.

name: PBR Albedo Safe
description: Correct albedo to configurable linear reflectance bounds, with metallic influence. This is an artist aid rather than a universal material-validity test.

name: PBR Validate
description: Show out-of-range albedo, metallic reflectance or both as a heatmap or invalid-pixel mask. Thresholds are explicit; input maps are never modified.

name: PBR Workflow Convert
description: Convert linear base color, metallic and roughness into diffuse, specular, glossiness and roughness outputs. Dielectric F0 is explicit; engine-specific packed formats remain separate.

name: Season
description: Seasonal color and roughness variation on a material, controlled by a mask.

name: Snow Cover
description: Add snow using surface orientation, optional coverage and height; outputs all material channels.

name: Water Level
description: Wet a material below a position-map level with adjustable transition, darkening and roughness.

name: Brightness / contrast
description: Apply brightness and contrast around the middle of a scalar mask.

name: Clamp
description: Limit scalar values between minimum and maximum without rescaling the range.

name: Compare
description: Compare two values and return a boolean condition.

name: Custom HLSL
description: Write bounded HLSL material math with up to eight typed inputs and one result. UV, Position and Normal are built in. Compile applies the successful draft.

name: Float Curve
description: Apply a bounded editable scalar response curve to a mask or value.

name: Gamma
description: Change grayscale midtone response while retaining black and white endpoints.

name: Invert
description: Return one minus the input mask. White becomes black and black becomes white.

name: Map Range
description: Remap between input and output ranges, with optional clamping.

name: Math
description: Choose a scalar mathematical operation with numeric defaults for disconnected inputs.

name: Multi Switch
description: Select one of seven inputs with an integer selector. Defaults to a uniform value for missing inputs.

name: Physics brush
description: Paint a reusable source, then simulate water flow or dirt transport on mesh-connected surface cells. Gravity moves material; evaporation dries water; deposition leaves a mask. Edit settings to replay. This is a surface-film solver, not a volumetric fluid.

name: Posterize
description: Reduce a grayscale input to a chosen number of levels.

name: Reaction Diffusion
description: Deterministic Gray-Scott simulation seeded by the input field. Feed/kill/diffusion and step controls.

name: Remap
description: Shift and scale an input value into the chosen range. Useful for procedural mask contrast.

name: Reroute
description: Organize a connection without changing its value or inferred type. Double-click a wire to insert a reroute.

name: Smoothstep
description: Create a soft threshold between two edges.

name: Switch
description: Choose between two inputs according to a boolean condition.

name: Mask Output
description: Final grayscale mask for this effect or folder. White reveals and black hides. It does not change the material channel values.

name: Material Output
description: Final material channels for this layer or effect: color, roughness, metallic, normal, height, AO, emission and opacity. Roughness and metallic are clamped to 0â€“1.

name: Output Texture (Anchor)
description: Publish a named texture snapshot into this project. Reuse it in any layer or graph, including other texture sets. Update refreshes existing linked uses; publication is explicit.
